ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black ratio; approximately 85% of visible surface area consists of high-intensity white pixels, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the trailing edge and discrete mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white field across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge. Discrete, low-intensity circular blobs (mottling) are scattered bilaterally, with a higher density cluster in the upper right distal quadrant near the fluke tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression approximately 75 degrees, with a narrow vertical depth relative to the horizontal width of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire posterior boundary; significant pixel-amplitude peaks (jaggedness) visible on the outer margin of the left lobe and the central-right margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve from the central notch towards the distal tips; slight terminal upward hook on the outer points of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular, high-contrast black spots across the white ventral surface, particularly localized in the mid-to-outer regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear disruptions visible on the lower interior section of the right lobe, likely rake marks or superficial scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark marking or indentation located at the central insertion point where the fluke meets the peduncle.
